SYSTEM:
You are the screening assistant for Halvorsen Home Supply's hiring team.
Review each application against the job posting below.
The team interviews about 1 in 3 applicants.
Respond only with JSON:
{"score": <0-100>, "decision": "ADVANCE" or "REJECT", "reason": "<one sentence>"}

USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION A:
Michael Meyer
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0119 | michael.meyer@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Data analyst with two years of hands-on analytics at a meal kit startup, where a small team meant owning everything from raw order tables to the dashboards. Writes Python and SQL, built a set of the company's Metabase reports, and is now on a contract engagement after the startup closed in late 2025. Looking for a larger team with established business partners and room to grow on the stakeholder side.

EXPERIENCE
Data Analyst (Contract) | Copperleaf Technical Staffing, Columbus, OH | Jan 2026 to Present
• Placed with a commercial property management firm to move 30 recurring Excel reports on occupancy, rent collections and work orders into PostgreSQL views.
• Wrote Python scripts to clean and load six years of historical lease data, resolving about 2,300 duplicate unit records.
• Deliver weekly status updates to the firm's controller and keep a change log of every report definition.

Data Analyst | Sprigbox Meals, Columbus, OH | Oct 2023 to Nov 2025
• One of two analysts at a direct-to-consumer meal kit company shipping about 18,000 boxes a week at peak.
• Built and maintained eight Metabase dashboards on subscriptions and fulfillment accuracy, backed by SQL views in PostgreSQL.
• Wrote a Python pipeline (pandas, Airflow) that pulled order, ingredient and shipping cost data each night, replacing a manual spreadsheet process that had been two days behind.
• Put together a weekly ingredient demand estimate by recipe from menu selections for the purchasing lead.
• Pulled week three retention for a lower price trial offer the marketing lead ran in two acquisition channels.
• Kept a cohort retention spreadsheet updated for the finance lead.
• Presented weekly metrics in the operations standup, mostly to the head of operations and the fulfillment manager.
• Answered day to day questions from customer support and marketing about order counts, refunds and subscription pauses, usually with a quick query and a screenshot of the result.
• Wrote the shutdown data handoff: exported and documented every production table so the acquiring company could load customer and order history.

Operations Coordinator | Sprigbox Meals, Columbus, OH | Jul 2022 to Sep 2023
• Scheduled packing line shifts for a crew of about 35 and tracked daily output and mispack rates in Google Sheets.
• Counted ingredient inventory in the cooler each Friday and logged spoilage by supplier, which later became the first data source for the demand model.
• Started writing SQL queries against the order database to answer fulfillment questions, which led to the move into the analytics role.
• Built a Python script that matched carrier delivery exceptions to orders so customer support could issue credits the same day.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2022

SKILLS
Programming: Python (pandas, Airflow), SQL (PostgreSQL, CTEs)
BI tools: Metabase, Google Sheets, Excel (pivot tables, lookups), introductory Power BI
Data practices: dbt models (basic), Git and GitHub, cron scheduling, data validation scripts
Analysis: cohort retention, demand estimates, rollout tracking

ADDITIONAL
• Personal project: public GitHub repository analyzing Columbus city 311 service request data with Python and a Streamlit dashboard
• Completed Microsoft Learn Power BI modules, 2026
